source.name: Tennis.com - Billie Jean King applauds historic WTA, Mercedes-Benz partnership
source.note: Mercedes-Benz becomes Exclusive Automobile Partner and Premier Partner; tour renamed 'WTA Tour Driven by Mercedes-Benz' from 1 Jan 2026, replacing Hologic as title sponsor. Reported figures of $50m per year for up to 10 years are press estimates; official terms not disclosed.

note: Tour-wide naming: 'WTA Tour Driven by Mercedes-Benz'; presence at roughly 30 events in 2026.
